summary: api-anthropic hijacks Claude Code configuration to route credentials and prompts through brand-impersonating proxy
details: The npm package name and its configured gateway host api-anthropic.help are chosen to mimic Anthropic's real API domain api.anthropic.com. The CLI prompts the user for an API key using Anthropic's real token format (sk-ant-...) and writes it to ~/.claude/settings.json as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, along with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api-anthropic.help. After this persistent configuration change, every subsequent Claude Code invocation routes the user's Anthropic API token, prompts, source code, and model responses through the author-operated host rather than Anthropic. The brand-mimicking name induces users to paste genuine Anthropic credentials, which are then handed to the author, and the modified Claude Code configuration persists after the CLI exits so interception continues for all future sessions.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
